visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men in white t-shirts are seen crouching on a dark asphalt road at night. One man has his hands behind his head, casting a shadow on the ground in front of him. The scene is illuminated by an off-screen light source, creating sharp shadows. (2) The camera focuses on the shadow cast on the ground, which resembles a cat's head with ears. The lighting highlights the texture of the asphalt. Yellow subtitles and a colorful logo appear at the top right. (3) Two people, a woman in a white cap and glasses and a man in a white t-shirt, stand up. The woman holds up a black backpack while they interact playfully. The background is a dark urban street with distant lights. (4) The scene shifts to a series of close-ups showing various embroidered patches and accessories pinned to the black backpack. Hands are seen adjusting the items. Large text overlays describe each accessory. (5) Three individuals stand side-by-side in a medium full shot, with the person in the center holding a blue cardboard box branded with 'DOUGHNUT'. The lighting is bright and even on the subjects. (6) A top-down close-up shot shows the interior of the blue box as it is opened, revealing the black backpack and a set of illustrated stickers or cards. Hands point to the features of the bag, including velcro straps. (7) A final graphic screen appears with a white background and black text, listing release dates and physical store locations, along with brand logos.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-arousal male speech, featuring excited inflections and a fast rate as they discuss the shadow. There is a faint urban ambient floor. (2) A sharp 'ding' sound effect triggers a transition to an upbeat, high-tempo electronic pop BGM with a strong four-on-the-floor beat. A female voice joins with a joyful tone and high pitch variability. (3) The voices transition into a more structured but high-energy promotional dialogue. The vocal intensity is high, with overlapping speech and laughter. The BGM remains constant in the background. (4) Rapid narration describes accessories, accompanied by short 'pop' and 'whoosh' sound effects that emphasize each visual cut. The speech rate is very fast. (5) A group shout of '哈哈大禮包' occurs with high vocal arousal and unity. (6) Auditory textures of rustling fabric and the mechanical clicking of buckles are clearly audible over the music. The voices are casual and friendly. (7) A clear, professional male voiceover delivers the final release details with a falling intonation at the end of phrases. The music swells slightly before fading out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To announce and promote a collaborative backpack and accessory kit between the brand 'Doughnut' and the media channel 'HahaTai'. The video uses a humorous hook and energetic presentation to appeal to the channel's fan base.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of the product, inclusion of brand logos (Doughnut), and specific release information for a commercial product.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively bridges social-media humor (the shadow cat) with commercial promotion. The use of 'HahaTai' signature style (yellow subtitles, variety-show SFX) makes the advertisement feel like native content for the audience.
